name: Wenchang LC-101
manufacturer: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corp
best_known_for: China's heavy-lift pad — Long March 5 to Tianhe, Chang'e 5/6, Tianwen-1, and the lunar return programme
credit: Long March 5 / 5B pad at Wenchang Space Launch Site on Hainan Island. First flight Long March 7 in June 2016; first Long March 5 in November 2016. Wenchang's southern latitude (19.6°N) adds free orbital velocity vs the older inland sites — that's how China can fly Long March 5B with the 25-tonne LEO payload class. Lifted the Tianhe core module (April 2021), Chang'e 5 (November 2020), Chang'e 6 (May 2024), Tianwen-1 (July 2020). Coordinates from CNSA + Xichang Satellite Launch Center public records.
